title: 索尼A7R6 × 85mm F1.4 GM II人像写真
title_en: Sony A7R6 × 85mm F1.4 GM II Portrait Shoot

scenes.title_cn: 开场：画质旗舰 × 人像镜皇
scenes.title_en: Opening: Resolution Flagship Meets Portrait King

sentences.zh: 索尼 A7R6 凭借着全新的 CMOS 和处理器的组合，成为了目前索尼全画幅微单系统中的画质旗舰。
sentences.en: With its brand-new CMOS and processor combo, the Sony A7R6 has become the resolution flagship of Sony's full-frame mirrorless lineup.
sentences.note: 画质旗舰 → resolution flagship（比 image-quality king 更贴科技评测）

sentences.zh: 那今天呢我们就把它和 85 F1.4 GM 二代镜头组合在一起，看看它们能迸发出怎样的精彩瞬间。
sentences.en: Today we're pairing it with the 85mm F1.4 GM II to see what kind of magical moments this combo can deliver.
sentences.note: 迸发 → deliver / spark；口语可用 magical moments

sentences.zh: 索尼画质旗舰 A7R6 和人像镜皇 85 F1.4 GM 二代这套组合，可以算是全画幅人像写真类拍摄的顶配了。
sentences.en: The A7R6 plus the 85mm F1.4 GM II — Sony's portrait king — is basically the top-tier setup for full-frame portrait work.
sentences.note: 镜皇 → portrait king；顶配 → top-tier / maxed-out setup

sentences.zh: 顶级画质表现配上索尼 GM 大师系列的顶级定焦镜头，会迸发出怎样的火花，我们同样期待。
sentences.en: Pair elite resolution with a G Master prime, and we're just as curious about the sparks that'll fly.
sentences.note: 迸发火花 → sparks that'll fly（比喻保留）

paraphrase.label: 介绍顶配组合：可以算是……的顶配了
paraphrase.en: This is basically the top-tier / maxed-out setup for…

paraphrase.label: 抛出期待：看看它们能迸发出怎样的精彩瞬间
paraphrase.en: Let's see what kind of magical moments this combo can deliver.

paraphrase.label: 人像镜皇：人像镜皇
paraphrase.en: the portrait king / the go-to portrait lens

sentences.zh: 这台索尼 A7R6 搭载了全新开发的 6680 万像素全画幅堆栈式 CMOS，配合新一代 BIONZ XR2 影像处理器。
sentences.en: The A7R6 packs a newly developed 61-megapixel full-frame stacked CMOS, paired with the next-gen BIONZ XR2 image processor.
sentences.note: 搭载 → packs / is equipped with；堆栈式 → stacked

sentences.zh: 读出速度比上一代的 A7R5 提升了约 5.6 倍。
sentences.en: Readout speed is about 5.6× faster than the previous A7R5.
sentences.note: 读出速度 → readout speed

sentences.zh: 而 85 F1.4 GM 二代作为索尼人像镜头的钢顶之作，比上一代轻了 178g，体积也缩小了 13%。
sentences.en: And the 85mm F1.4 GM II — Sony's crowning portrait lens — is 178g lighter and 13% smaller than its predecessor.
sentences.note: 钢顶之作 → crowning / crowning achievement

sentences.zh: 它们两个组合在一起重心配比合理，长时间手持拍摄并不会觉得头重脚轻。
sentences.en: Together, the balance feels right — even long handheld shoots don't feel front-heavy.
sentences.note: 头重脚轻 → front-heavy（摄影常用）

sentences.zh: 画质也是目前整个 135 全画幅系统里的顶峰之一。
sentences.en: Image quality also sits near the peak of today's 35mm full-frame systems.
sentences.note: 135 → 35mm full-frame

paraphrase.label: 描述装备配置：搭载了全新开发的……
paraphrase.en: It packs a newly developed…

paraphrase.label: 手持重心：不会觉得头重脚轻
paraphrase.en: doesn't feel front-heavy / top-heavy

paraphrase.label: 对比上一代：比上一代轻了 178g
paraphrase.en: is 178g lighter than its predecessor

scenes.title_cn: 毛孔级细节：碾碎放大焦虑

sentences.zh: 先说画质——放大到毛孔级别的恐怖细节。人像拍摄最怕什么？放大一看，发丝糊成一团，睫毛边缘发虚。
sentences.en: First, resolution — terrifying detail down to the pore level. What's a portrait shooter's worst fear? You zoom in and the hair melts into mush, lash edges go soft.
sentences.note: 恐怖细节 → terrifying detail（保留夸张语气）

sentences.zh: 索尼 A7R6 的 6600 万像素，加上 85 GM 二代在 F1.4 全开时的中心解析力，直接把这个焦虑给碾碎了。
sentences.en: The A7R6's 61MP, plus the GM II's center sharpness wide open at F1.4, just crushes that anxiety.
sentences.note: 碾碎焦虑 → crushes that anxiety

sentences.zh: 实测中我们在各种复杂光源环境下拍摄了人像测试，F1.4 光圈全开，对焦点锁定在模特的眼睛上。
sentences.en: In real tests we shot portraits under all kinds of tricky lighting — F1.4 wide open, focus locked on the model's eye.
sentences.note: 复杂光源 → tricky lighting

sentences.zh: 回家导入电脑放大到 200%，焦点处的每一个细节都清晰可辨；瞳孔中的眼神光都可以呈现出一个完整的光斑。
sentences.en: Back home, we punched in to 200% on the computer — every detail at the focus point stayed crystal clear, and the catchlight in the pupil even showed as a complete specular highlight.
sentences.note: 眼神光 → catchlight；光斑 → specular highlight / specular disc

sentences.zh: 再次放大，眼睛虹膜的纹理层次分明，细节表现堪称恐怖。
sentences.en: Zoom in again: iris texture is layered and crisp — the detail is honestly scary-good.
sentences.note: 虹膜 → iris；堪称恐怖 → scary-good

paraphrase.label: 表达痛点：人像拍摄最怕什么
paraphrase.en: What's a portrait shooter's worst fear?

paraphrase.label: 碾碎焦虑：直接把这个焦虑给碾碎了
paraphrase.en: just crushes that anxiety / puts that worry to rest

paraphrase.label: 眼神光：瞳孔中的眼神光
paraphrase.en: the catchlight in the pupil

paraphrase.label: 放大检视：放大到 200%
paraphrase.en: punch in to 200% / zoom in to 200%

scenes.title_cn: 边缘画质：半身构图实测

sentences.zh: 更让我们感到惊喜的是边缘画质：85 GM 二代在 F1.4 全开时，边缘分辨率显著优于一代。
sentences.en: What surprised us even more was the edge performance — wide open at F1.4, the GM II's edge resolution clearly beats the Mark I.
sentences.note: 一代 → the Mark I / Gen 1

sentences.zh: 我们拍了一组半身构图，模特位于画面右侧三分之一处；放大看焦点细节，纹理锐利，没有糊成一片。
sentences.en: We shot a half-body set with the model on the right third of the frame. Zoom in on the focus point — textures stay razor-sharp, not smeared.
sentences.note: 糊成一片 → smeared / mushy

sentences.zh: 在索尼 85 F1.4 GM 二代的优秀光学表现下，画面边缘依然保持着极高的解析力水准。
sentences.en: Thanks to the GM II's optics, even the frame edges still hold a very high resolving standard.
sentences.note: 解析力水准 → resolving standard / resolving power

paraphrase.label: 边缘画质惊喜：更让我们感到惊喜的是边缘画质
paraphrase.en: What surprised us even more was the edge performance

paraphrase.label: 构图位置：模特位于画面右侧三分之一处
paraphrase.en: with the model on the right third of the frame

paraphrase.label: 锐利不糊：纹理锐利没有糊成一片
paraphrase.en: textures stay razor-sharp, not smeared

sentences.zh: 再来聊一下索尼 A7R6 机身——这个顶配的 8.5 档防抖。高像素机型最大的敌人从来不是对焦，而是抖动。
sentences.en: Next up, the A7R6 body — that maxed-out 8.5-stop IBIS. On high-res bodies, the real enemy was never AF — it's camera shake.
sentences.note: 8.5 档防抖 → 8.5-stop IBIS

sentences.zh: 6600 万像素的传感器对任何微小的震动都极其敏感；以往高像素机型拍人像，快门速度永远都是摄影师警惕的关键。
sentences.en: A 61MP sensor is extremely sensitive to the tiniest vibration. With older high-res bodies, shutter speed was always the number photographers watched like a hawk.
sentences.note: 警惕的关键 → watched like a hawk

sentences.zh: A7R6 上的 8.5 档机身防抖是索尼目前最强的防抖系统。实测中我们在光线较暗的室内拍摄，快门即使降到 1/30 秒，成片率依然非常高。
sentences.en: The A7R6's 8.5-stop in-body stabilization is Sony's strongest yet. In dim indoor tests, even at 1/30s, keeper rates stayed impressively high.
sentences.note: 成片率 → keeper rate

sentences.zh: 放大看模特的眼睛，清晰锐利没有重影。这对人像摄影师来说是一个实实在在的生产力提升。
sentences.en: Zoom in on the model's eyes — sharp, clean, no double imaging. For portrait shooters, that's a real productivity boost.
sentences.note: 重影 → double imaging / ghosting

sentences.zh: 你不再需要时刻担心这张糊没糊，可以把更多注意力放在构图和与模特的沟通上。
sentences.en: You stop constantly worrying whether the shot is soft, and can put more attention on framing and directing the model.
sentences.note: 糊没糊 → whether the shot is soft；沟通 → directing / communicating with

paraphrase.label: 真正的敌人：最大的敌人从来不是对焦，而是抖动
paraphrase.en: the real enemy was never AF — it's camera shake

paraphrase.label: 成片率：成片率依然非常高
paraphrase.en: keeper rates stayed impressively high

paraphrase.label: 生产力提升：实实在在的生产力提升
paraphrase.en: a real / tangible productivity boost

paraphrase.label: 把注意力放回创作：可以把更多注意力放在构图和沟通上
paraphrase.en: put more attention on framing and directing the model

scenes.title_cn: AI 姿态识别与跟焦碾压

sentences.zh: 在自动对焦表现上，A7R6 这次搭载的 AI 人体姿态识别，模特背身也能牢牢锁住。
sentences.en: On AF, the A7R6's AI human-pose recognition keeps a lock even when the model turns her back.
sentences.note: 牢牢锁住 → keeps a lock / locks on hard

sentences.zh: 在人像摄影中，模特不可能永远正脸对着镜头——转身、低头、侧脸、被前景挡住，这些都是常态。
sentences.en: In portrait work, the model won't face the camera forever — turning away, looking down, profile shots, getting blocked by foreground — that's all normal.
sentences.note: 常态 → that's all normal / par for the course

sentences.zh: 无论模特如何摆姿，绿色对焦框始终牢牢锁在她的眼睛上，一次都没丢；即使背对镜头，也能锁定头部和身体。
sentences.en: No matter how she poses, the green AF box stays glued to her eye — never lost it once. Even back-to-camera, it can lock onto head and body.
sentences.note: 牢牢锁 → stays glued to

sentences.zh: 另外 85 GM 二代的双 XD 线性马达组，对焦速度较上一代提升了三倍；这套组合的跟焦能力堪称碾压。
sentences.en: Plus the GM II's dual XD linear motors are about 3× faster than the previous generation — this combo's subject tracking is basically unfair.
sentences.note: 堪称碾压 → basically unfair / in a league of its own

sentences.zh: 模特在镜头前随意走动、转身甩头发，相机就像长了眼睛一样死死咬住瞳孔；每秒多次 AF/AE 计算，确保每张曝光准确、焦点扎实。
sentences.en: She walks freely, spins, flips her hair — the camera feels like it has eyes of its own, glued to the pupil. Continuous AF/AE calculations keep every frame properly exposed with solid focus.
sentences.note: 死死咬住 → glued to / locked onto

paraphrase.label: 背身锁定：模特背身也能牢牢锁住
paraphrase.en: keeps a lock even when the model turns her back

paraphrase.label: 对焦框不丢：绿色对焦框始终牢牢锁在眼睛上
paraphrase.en: the green AF box stays glued to her eye

paraphrase.label: 跟焦碾压：跟焦能力堪称碾压
paraphrase.en: subject tracking is basically unfair / in a league of its own
chunks: in a league of its own

paraphrase.label: 甩发抓拍：转身甩头发……死死咬住瞳孔
paraphrase.en: spins and flips her hair — glued to the pupil

sentences.zh: 顺便我们还体验了一下 85 F1.4 二代 11 片光圈叶片的奶油虚化感。
sentences.en: We also got a taste of the GM II's creamy bokeh from its 11-blade aperture.
sentences.note: 奶油虚化 → creamy bokeh

sentences.zh: F1.4 全开时背景虚化如奶油般化开，背景光斑边缘柔和，二线性控制非常优秀，带有纹理和纵深的柔和虚化过渡。
sentences.en: Wide open at F1.4, the background melts like butter — soft-edged highlights, excellent onion-ring control, and a gentle transition with texture and depth.
sentences.note: 二线性 → onion rings；虚化过渡 → bokeh transition

sentences.zh: 我们在室外拍了一组人像：背景是层层叠叠的树叶和斑驳的光影。F1.4 全开，散景光斑圆润柔和，像一幅印象派油画。
sentences.en: Outdoors we shot a set against layered leaves and dappled light. Wide open, the bokeh balls are round and soft — like an Impressionist painting.
sentences.note: 斑驳光影 → dappled light；散景光斑 → bokeh balls

sentences.zh: 而模特面部锐度丝毫不减，皮肤的质感和光影过渡自然细腻。
sentences.en: Yet facial sharpness doesn't drop off at all — skin texture and light falloff stay natural and refined.
sentences.note: 丝毫不减 → doesn't drop off at all

paraphrase.label: 奶油虚化：背景虚化如奶油般化开
paraphrase.en: the background melts like butter / creamy bokeh

paraphrase.label: 斑驳光影：斑驳的光影
paraphrase.en: dappled light / mottled light and shadow

paraphrase.label: 印象派比喻：像一幅印象派的油画
paraphrase.en: like an Impressionist painting

scenes.title_cn: AI 自动白平衡：混合光源肤色
scenes.title_en: AI Auto WB: Skin Tones in Mixed Light

sentences.zh: 索尼 A7R6 这次也新增了基于 AI 深度学习的自动白平衡，结合可见光与红外线传感器判断光源。
sentences.en: The A7R6 also adds AI deep-learning auto white balance, combining visible-light and IR sensors to read the light source.
sentences.note: 自动白平衡 → auto white balance (AWB)

sentences.zh: 实际拍摄中，在混合光源——比如窗外日光加室内暖黄灯光——的环境下，模特的肤色依然呈现出健康自然的质感。
sentences.en: In mixed lighting — say daylight from the window plus warm indoor lamps — skin tones still look healthy and natural.
sentences.note: 混合光源 → mixed lighting

sentences.zh: 没有出现偏黄或者偏青的情况；后期调色时就不用费心费力地校正白平衡了。
sentences.en: No weird yellow or cyan cast — so in post you don't have to sweat correcting white balance.
sentences.note: 偏青 → cyan cast；费心费力 → sweat / fuss over

paraphrase.label: 混合光源举例：窗外日光加室内暖黄灯光
paraphrase.en: daylight from the window plus warm indoor lamps

paraphrase.label: 肤色自然：肤色依然呈现出健康自然的质感
paraphrase.en: skin tones still look healthy and natural

paraphrase.label: 省后期：不用费心费力地校正白平衡
paraphrase.en: you don't have to sweat correcting white balance

scenes.title_cn: 值不值得：生产力工具结语

sentences.zh: 总结一下这套组合值不值得：索尼 A7R6 和 85 GM 二代加起来超过三万，并不算便宜。
sentences.en: So — is the combo worth it? The A7R6 plus the 85 GM II runs well over 30,000 yuan; it's not cheap.
sentences.note: 值不值得 → is it worth it?

sentences.zh: 但如果你是一个以人像写真为核心的职业摄影师或者深度爱好者，这套组合带来的体验是无可替代的。
sentences.en: But if you're a working portrait photographer or a serious enthusiast with portraits at the center, the experience this combo delivers is hard to replace.
sentences.note: 深度爱好者 → serious enthusiast；无可替代 → hard to replace

sentences.zh: 6680 万像素带来的恐怖解析力、8.5 档防抖带来的手持信心、AI 对焦带来的抓拍效率、85 GM 二代全开时巅峰的画质——
sentences.en: Terrifying resolving power from ~61MP, handheld confidence from 8.5-stop IBIS, grab-shot efficiency from AI AF, peak wide-open optics from the GM II —
sentences.note: 手持信心 → handheld confidence；抓拍效率 → grab-shot efficiency

sentences.zh: 如果把它们当做高效出片的生产力工具的话，可以说每一分钱都花在了刀刃上。
sentences.en: Treat them as productivity tools for shipping strong images efficiently, and every yuan is spent where it counts.
sentences.note: 花在刀刃上 → spent where it counts / money well spent

paraphrase.label: 值不值得：这套组合值不值得
paraphrase.en: Is the combo worth it?

paraphrase.label: 目标用户：以人像写真为核心的职业摄影师
paraphrase.en: a working portrait photographer with portraits at the center

paraphrase.label: 花在刀刃上：每一分钱都花在了刀刃上
paraphrase.en: every yuan is spent where it counts / money well spent

paraphrase.label: 高效出片：高效出片的生产力工具
paraphrase.en: productivity tools for shipping strong images efficiently

practice.en: This is basically the top-tier setup for full-frame portraits.

practice.zh: 用「crushes that anxiety」表达彻底解决某类担心
practice.en: The center sharpness wide open just crushes that pixel-peeping anxiety.
Even at 1/30s indoors, keeper rates stayed impressively high.

practice.zh: 用「stays glued to」描述对焦不丢
practice.en: The AF box stays glued to her eye the whole time.
